note: The HDF5 superblock bytes from the input file are loaded into the metadata cache image and decoded as the file superblock prefix.
The input-controlled superblock version is saved and later controls whether checksum verification is performed.
A version 2 or later superblock takes the checksum verification path.
The function assumes the caller-provided metadata image length is at least H5_SIZEOF_CHKSUM bytes before reading the stored checksum.
When buf_size is smaller than H5_SIZEOF_CHKSUM, the checksum pointer is computed before the beginning of the loaded image buffer.
Decoding a 32-bit checksum from the underflowed pointer performs a 4-byte heap-buffer-overflow read.
